detail_totals.schedule: Schedule M - General Fund Disbursements vs Budget

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition Fund is a governmental fund here), business_type null. Receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (pp16-18); fund roll-forward on p19 (beginning 10,812,023.70, ending 11,797,703.38) and reconciles with receipts 17,843,154.55 - disbursements 16,857,474.87 + transfers in 1,002,350.98 - transfers out 1,002,350.98 (printed totals 18,720,055.53 / 17,734,375.85 include the 876,900.98 hidden transfer). Beginning/ending cash set to the fund balance roll-forward (all cash). Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (Exhibit I, p1) Governmental Activities column; component unit (Educational Facilities Leasing Corporation, 4,608.39 net position, 1,300,000 debt service) excluded. Local Receipts (8,470,174.36) split by fund column (pp8-9): General/Special Building/QCPU 8,175,644.43 as property tax (review, General Fund local not broken down) and Activities/Student Fee/School Nutrition 294,529.93 as charges for services/fees. 'Allocation From General Fund' 876,900.98 is printed as a receipt in the Depreciation Fund (850,000.00) and Employee Benefit Fund (26,900.98) while the General Fund shows no matching outflow line except 2730 Property 850,000.00 (p29); the government-wide statement (p7 Other 1,002,529.08 = 876,900.98 + 125,628.10) does not eliminate it. Per the hidden-transfer rule it is recorded as transfers_in (not a receipt); the 850,000.00 is split out of Vehicle Servicing & Maintenance (split_from, review) into transfers_out, and for the 26,900.98 (General Fund line not shown) a contra disbursement line plus transfers_out is used; Sch M 2730 Property is an other financing line of -850,000.00, with a matching contra/other financing pair for 26,900.98. reported_totals stay as printed with includes_split. Debt Service principal/interest not split. Detail: only Schedule M (General Fund operational disbursements vs budget, pp20-31) is a supplementary schedule; it is more detailed than the fund-column statement so only it is recorded for the General Fund. Zero/blank actual lines skipped (e.g., 1300 Summer School, 2142, 2143, 2713, 3551, budget-only lines). Object mapping: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance; Other Property Services -> professional/contract services; Property -> equipment purchases; Other Items -> dues, training and travel. 1200 Special Education Supplies read as 38,488.85 (sums to printed 2,110,789.71). Schedule M total 14,015,399.90 includes the 8000 Transfers (125,450.00) recorded as other financing. Other fund columns on pp8-15 not recorded in detail (basic statement). Read pages 1-31 of 31.
